newsitem.title: GERMANY: Danzas Germany MD resigns at short notice.
newsitem.headline: Danzas Germany MD resigns at short notice.

text.p: The managing director of Danzas AG in Germany, Michael Villinger, has stepped down with effect from Friday Feb 28, the Swiss freight forwarder said.

Villinger will leave the company at his own wish on August 31 but will hand over responsibility as managing director and manager of the Eurocargo Germany division on February 28, a company statement issued here said.
A spokeswoman said she could not comment on a German media report that Villinger quit in disagreement with corporate re-structuring plans including job losses in Germany.
Villinger had been managing director of Danzas Holding GmbH in Germany since 1992.
His replacement will be named at a later date. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
